@@ -35,6 +36,25 @@ def test_custom_headers(config_stub, dnt, accept_language, custom_headers,
     assert shared.custom_headers(url=None) == expected_items
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('url, fallback, expected_language', [
+    (None, False, b'global'),
+    (QUrl('https://example.org/'), True, b'global'),
+    (QUrl('https://example.org/'), False, None),
+    (QUrl('https://example.com/'), False, b'local'),
+])
+def test_custom_headers_accept_language_fallback(
+        config_stub, url, fallback, expected_language):
+    config_stub.val.content.headers.accept_language = 'global'
+    config_stub.set_obj('content.headers.accept_language', 'local',
+                        pattern=urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://example.com/*'))
+
+    headers = dict(shared.custom_headers(
+        url=url, fallback_accept_language=fallback))
+    assert headers.get(b'Accept-Language') == expected_language
+    if fallback:
+        assert shared.custom_headers(url=url) == sorted(headers.items())
+
+

index 099ba69..000ae70 100644
--- a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webengineinterceptor.py
+++ b/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webengineinterceptor.py
@@ -15,7 +15,7 @@ from qutebrowser.qt.webenginecore import QWebEngineUrlRequestInfo
 
 from qutebrowser.browser.webengine import interceptor
 from qutebrowser.extensions import interceptors
-from qutebrowser.utils import qtutils
+from qutebrowser.utils import qtutils, urlmatch
 from helpers import testutils
 
 
@@ -37,6 +37,32 @@ def test_resource_type_values():
         assert qtutils.extract_enum_val(qt_value) == qb_item.value
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('resource_type, url, expected_language', [
+    (QWebEngineUrlRequestInfo.ResourceType.ResourceTypeXhr,
+     'https://example.org/', None),
+    (QWebEngineUrlRequestInfo.ResourceType.ResourceTypeXhr,
+     'https://example.com/', b'local'),
+    (QWebEngineUrlRequestInfo.ResourceType.ResourceTypeMainFrame,
+     'https://example.org/', b'global'),
+])
+def test_accept_language_for_xhr(
+        mocker, config_stub, resource_type, url, expected_language):
+    config_stub.val.content.headers.accept_language = 'global'
+    config_stub.set_obj('content.headers.accept_language', 'local',
+                        pattern=urlmatch.UrlPattern('*://example.com/*'))
+    mocker.patch.object(interceptor.websettings, 'user_agent', return_value='agent')
+    mocker.patch.object(interceptors, 'run')
+    info = mocker.Mock(spec=QWebEngineUrlRequestInfo)
+    info.requestUrl.return_value = QUrl(url)
+    info.firstPartyUrl.return_value = QUrl('https://example.org/')
+    info.resourceType.return_value = resource_type
+
+    interceptor.RequestInterceptor().interceptRequest(info)
+
+    headers = dict(call.args for call in info.setHttpHeader.call_args_list)
+    assert headers.get(b'Accept-Language') == expected_language
+
+
